bootstrapDb.description: Name of the database the AGE server initialises and probes; no client reads it.

enabled.description: Render the AGE-on-CNPG `Cluster` (templates/age-cluster.yaml); mutually exclusive with `age.enabled`. Needs an extension image, K8s 1.33+ and the CloudNativePG operator (>= 1.27), a prerequisite: the render refuses on a cluster that does not serve postgresql.cnpg.io/v1.

extensionImage.description: The built AGE extension image for the CNPG cluster (e.g. ghcr.io/<org>/age-cnpg-ext:1.7.0-18); required when `cnpgCluster.enabled`, no default.

enabled.description: Run the in-cluster apache/age Postgres StatefulSet that serves the OpenFGA and Dapr state store databases.

externalHost.description: Postgres host OpenFGA and the Dapr state store use instead of the in-cluster AGE; the render refuses it empty with age.enabled=false.

image.description: Postgres+AGE image for the StatefulSet and the pg_dump backup job (PG16; 1.6.0 is multi-arch amd64+arm64).

openfgaDb.description: Name of the database OpenFGA uses as its datastore.

port.description: Postgres port of the AGE store, used by every client DSN, the backup job and the network policy.

storage.description: PVC size of the AGE StatefulSet. Immutable after install: the chart fails an upgrade that changes it (see docs/runbooks/RUNBOOK-restore.md).

user.description: Postgres user every AGE client connects as; its password is the store's `postgres` secret (field `password`), never a value.

arenaMax.description: MALLOC_ARENA_MAX set on every lakehouse container (lance.allocatorEnv) to cap glibc malloc arenas. Default 2.

arrowMemoryPool.description: ARROW_DEFAULT_MEMORY_POOL on every lakehouse container; `system` routes Arrow through malloc so `arenaMax` bounds it.

audit.description: Emit the structured authn/authz/credential-vending audit stream (LANCE_AUDIT_ENABLED and siblings); takes effect only with auth on. false silences it.

bootstrapAdmin.description: The person's principal (`<idp-id>~<user id>`, e.g. `dex~<userID>`) the bootstrap-admin hook grants `owner` on the default warehouse and `admin` on estate:rask; a bare name fails the render. Empty = human grants are made out of band.

enabled.description: Govern the estate: authn on every door plus OpenFGA authz. On by default (fails closed); a bare install then needs `auth.oidc.issuer` or it refuses to render. A real deployment refuses it off.

fgaApiUrl.description: The platform's OpenFGA HTTP API (e.g. `https://fga.internal:8080`), which the tuple writers (the catalog, maintenance), the openfga-model hook and the bootstrap-admin Job dial when `openfga.enabled` is false; the render refuses it empty then, and http on a real deployment. It must admit rask's projected `rask-openfga` tokens from exactly the subjects `lance.openfgaSubjects` lists: OIDC against the cluster's ServiceAccount issuer.

fgaEgress.description: NetworkPolicy egress rules ({to, ports}) admitting the pods that dial `fgaApiUrl` (the tuple writers, the openfga-model hook, the bootstrap-admin Job) to it, at the port a policy sees. Required under networkPolicy.enabled while `openfga.enabled` is false.

fgaModelId.description: Pin the OpenFGA authorization model id every service checks against, whatever its image carries. Empty = the store's latest model.

fgaStoreId.description: Pin the OpenFGA store id used by every service, the openfga-model hook and the bootstrap-admin Job. Empty = the newest store named `lance-catalog`.

enabled.description: Render the issuer mirror (templates/issuer-mirror.yaml) that republishes the SA issuer's discovery and JWKS unauthenticated for OpenFGA and the development store; off only for a publicly served issuer.

audience.description: The audience every governed door checks (`RASK_OIDC_AUDIENCE`); a client's own id is never it.

audienceScope.description: The scope a client asks the IdP for to obtain a token for `audience`; empty is Dex's cross-client scope, `audience:server:client_id:<audience>`.

connectors.description: The idp id each Dex connector's users are principals of, keyed by connector id (`RASK_OIDC_CONNECTORS`; `{ldap: corp}` makes user `u` of connector `ldap` the principal `corp~u`). An idp id is lower-case letters, digits and `-`, never `kubernetes`. With `dex.enabled` the development Dex's `local` connector is `dex` unless named here; otherwise at least one entry is required.

issuer.description: The OIDC issuer every governed door trusts (`RASK_OIDC_ISSUER`; a token is accepted only when its `iss` equals it). Required when `auth.enabled`; https unless `dex.enabled`.

enabled.description: Renders CPU-based HPAs for catalog and lineage, whose Deployments then render no `replicas` (the HPA owns the count). Needs metrics-server; off by default.

maxReplicas.description: HPA maximum replicas for catalog and lineage.

minReplicas.description: HPA minimum replicas for catalog and lineage.

scaleDownStabilizationSeconds.description: HPA scale-down stabilization window in seconds; stops a spiky service oscillating.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: HPA target CPU as a percentage of the pod's CPU request (not its limit).

dest.description: S3 URI the control-root backup is copied to. Empty writes `_backups/control/` inside the control root itself, which does not survive losing the bucket.

enabled.description: Schedule a CronJob that backs up the control root (project, warehouse, binding and bucket-claim registries). Off by default.

keep.description: Number of newest control-root backups kept after each successful copy; 0 keeps every run.

schedule.description: Cron schedule of the control-root backup (default daily 01:00, ahead of the pg dump).

enabled.description: Schedule a CronJob that pg_dumps the OpenFGA database (gzip) to `_backups/pg/<date>/` in the lakehouse bucket. It signs with a session its own ServiceAccount's token is exchanged for, and pg_dump reads its password from a PGPASSFILE. Off by default.

keep.description: Number of newest daily pg dumps kept; older ones are pruned on each run.

schedule.description: Cron schedule of the pg dump (default daily 02:00).

enabled.description: Schedule a CronJob that creates a CSI VolumeSnapshot of the lakehouse PVC; needs a CSI snapshotter and a VolumeSnapshotClass. Off by default.

kubectlImage.description: Image the snapshot job runs; it needs both a shell and kubectl.

schedule.description: Cron schedule of the volume snapshot (default daily 03:00).

snapshotClassName.description: VolumeSnapshotClass the snapshot names; empty uses the cluster default.

bindingName.description: Name of the commit-reconcile Dapr cron Component; also the catalog's LANCE_COMMIT_RECONCILE_BINDING_NAME and the route it serves.

graceSeconds.description: Seconds a committed version waits before the reconciler looks for its announcement (LANCE_COMMIT_RECONCILE_GRACE_SECONDS): longer than the inline publish and the outbox relay take to deliver it.

horizonSeconds.description: Seconds back the reconciler looks for a version's announcement (LANCE_COMMIT_RECONCILE_HORIZON_SECONDS); kept inside services.lineage.eventsRetentionDays.

schedule.description: Dapr cron schedule on which the catalog announces every committed version lineage's feed lacks.

controlConsumerInactiveSeconds.description: Seconds a catalog replica's control-event consumer outlives lost interest before NATS reaps it; also the broadcast mirror's message age.

controlDlqTopic.description: Dead-letter topic of the catalog's control subscription, for deliveries that exhaust their retries; set only with `controlEmit` and `dapr.resiliency.enabled`, since a dead-letter topic with no retry policy parks on the first failure.

controlEmit.description: Publish catalog control events (catalog.control.v1) on a broadcast Dapr topic; renders the control pubsub component, CATALOG_CONTROL stream and subscription. Best-effort.

bindingName.description: Name of the control relay's Dapr cron Component; also the catalog's LANCE_CONTROL_RELAY_BINDING_NAME and the route it serves. Must stay one string.

enabled.description: Stage control events in a durable S3 outbox and run the relay cron that drains it; carries `table_published` to its subscribers. Requires `controlEmit`.

schedule.description: Dapr cron schedule of the control outbox relay; bounds how long a control event stays undelivered after a bus outage.

bindingName.description: Name of the erasure-release Dapr cron Component; also the catalog's LANCE_ERASURE_RELEASE_BINDING_NAME and the route it serves.

deadlineDays.description: Days after an erasure obligation is recorded that it is due; an obligation still open past it is shown overdue (LANCE_ERASURE_DEADLINE_DAYS). Required.

releaseGraceDays.description: Days after an erasure blocked by a tag or branch pin, during which owners are told, before the pins are released (LANCE_ERASURE_RELEASE_GRACE_DAYS). Required.

schedule.description: Dapr cron schedule on which due erasure pin releases run; lateness only costs time.

bindingName.description: Name of the manifest-reclaim Dapr cron Component; also the catalog's LANCE_MANIFEST_RECLAIM_BINDING_NAME and the route it serves.

retainSeconds.description: Seconds a `__manifest` version is kept before the reclaim removes it (LANCE_MANIFEST_RETAIN_SECONDS); a dropped id stays readable in the history this long, and the catalog rebuilds each namespace connection after a quarter of it.

schedule.description: Dapr cron schedule on which each root's `__manifest` versions past retainSeconds are removed; lateness only keeps history longer.

maxBodyBytes.description: Maximum request-body bytes on any catalog route (LANCE_MAX_BODY_BYTES); larger bodies get 413 before buffering. Default 256 MiB.

maxConcurrentWrites.description: Cap on concurrent in-flight Arrow-IPC writes; over it the catalog answers 429 + Retry-After. Peak buffer memory is this times `maxBodyBytes`. 0 disables shedding.

dataBases.description: Allowlist of bucket URIs one table's fragments may be spread across (`?data_base=` on create). Empty = multi-base off, single-location creates.

bindingName.description: Name of the promotion-expiry Dapr cron Component; also the catalog's LANCE_PROMOTION_EXPIRY_BINDING_NAME and the route it serves.

schedule.description: Dapr cron schedule on which promotion holds past their review deadline expire; lateness only costs time.

trashGraceDays.description: Days, a fraction allowed, a dropped table or namespace stays undroppable, where its warehouse names no delete profile (LANCE_TRASH_GRACE_DAYS). 0 destroys immediately.

enabled.description: Per-warehouse physical multi-tenancy: POST /management/v1/warehouses provisions a bucket per warehouse and binds top-level namespaces to it. Unbound namespaces use `objectStore.bucket`.
Render the console: its Deployment, Service, `/config.json` ConfigMap, ServiceAccount and, with `route.enabled`, its `/` HTTPRoute.

clientId.description: The IdP's public client the console signs in with (PKCE, no secret); the development Dex declares `rask-console` (deploy/fixtures/dex `console`).

scopes.description: Scopes the console asks for; `federated:id` and the lakehouse's audience scope are always added.

port.description: Port of the console's static server and its Service.

replicas.description: Replicas of the console's static server.

resources.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the console's static server.

runAsUser.description: The image's non-root uid and gid (`USER 10001` in .docker/frontend.dockerfile), named by number so `runAsNonRoot` can verify it.

apiTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline in seconds for every DaprClient gRPC call (DAPR_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS), so a wedged sidecar fails a publish instead of hanging it.

controlPlaneNamespace.description: Namespace the Dapr control plane runs in; the Collector scrapes it and, under NetworkPolicy, every pod may reach it.

enabled.description: Deploy the Dapr dashboard web UI (templates/dapr-dashboard.yaml), reached by port-forward; requires `dapr.enabled`. Development only: a real deployment refuses it.

image.description: Container image for the Dapr dashboard Deployment.

enabled.description: Use Dapr: inject a daprd sidecar into every lakehouse pod and render rask's Components, Configurations and Resiliency. Needs a Dapr control plane (dapr.io/v1alpha1); the render refuses without it.

logLevel.description: daprd sidecar log level, stamped as the `dapr.io/log-level` annotation (debug, info, warn, error).

maxBodySize.description: Max request body for Dapr service invocation (`dapr.io/max-body-size`); Dapr's own default is 4Mi.

enabled.description: Render the Dapr Resiliency policy (sidecar retries, constant 120s x 4), per-app dead-letter topics, and the long broker backOff; false = broker-only.

cpuLimit.description: CPU limit for every injected daprd sidecar (`dapr.io/sidecar-cpu-limit`).

cpuRequest.description: CPU request for every injected daprd sidecar (`dapr.io/sidecar-cpu-request`).

memoryLimit.description: Memory limit for every injected daprd sidecar (`dapr.io/sidecar-memory-limit`).

memoryRequest.description: Memory request for every injected daprd sidecar (`dapr.io/sidecar-memory-request`).

sidecarRestricted.description: Add the RuntimeDefault seccomp annotation to daprd for PodSecurity `restricted`; also set the injector's `sidecarDropALLCapabilities`.

enabled.description: This estate uses the development Dex (deploy/fixtures/dex, Service `<release>-dex`): the ingress serves it at /dex, and a real deployment refuses it. The chart renders no Dex.

port.description: Port of the development Dex's Service.

enabled.description: Serves /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json on every app in the release. Off by default; turn on only for a dev cluster.

kubernetesAuthPath.description: Mount path of the store's Kubernetes auth method, which ESO's SecretStore and every app's sidecar log in through.

kvMount.description: Vault/OpenBao KV mount path the SecretStore reads from.

namespace.description: Namespace of the External Secrets Operator ServiceAccount the Vault role is bound to.

refreshInterval.description: How often each ExternalSecret re-syncs from the store (a duration, e.g. `1h`).

role.description: Vault role the operator's ServiceAccount assumes; also names its read policy.

serviceAccount.description: Name of the External Secrets Operator ServiceAccount the Vault role is bound to, so no other pod can assume it.

forwardedAllowIps.description: Peers whose x-forwarded-* headers uvicorn trusts in every pod the route reaches (--forwarded-allow-ips). Set to the Gateway data plane's pod CIDR; `*` is refused.

fullnameOverride.description: Base name for every rendered object; pinned to `rask` so in-cluster Services resolve as `rask-<component>`.

global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts
global.$comment: Added automatically by 'helm schema' to allow this chart to be used as a Helm dependency, as this schema would otherwise not allow Helm's special 'global' values key.

catalog.description: Lakehouse image (catalog, lineage, maintenance, and the chart's Jobs and hooks): `repository` is its name under image.repository; its tag or digest is `tags`/`digests` keyed by that name, else the global one.

console.description: Console image: `repository` is its name under image.repository; its tag or digest is `tags`/`digests` keyed by that name, else the global one.

digest.description: Global digest pin (sha256:...) for every first-party image; wins over `tag`. Empty uses tags.

digests.description: Per-component digest map keyed by component name; beats `tags` and the global tag.

localImages.description: Renders bare `<component>:<tag>` references for images side-loaded into the node (k3s-import). Never for a remote cluster.

repository.description: Registry prefix for every first-party image (e.g. ghcr.io/<org>/<repo>). Required unless localImages is true.

tag.description: Default tag for every first-party image when no per-component tag or digest is set.

tags.description: Per-component tag map keyed by component name (lance-rest-catalog, web-console); beats the global tag.

imagePullSecrets.description: List of pull Secrets ({name: ...}) added to every first-party pod and hook Job. Empty pulls anonymously.

maintenanceTerminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period in seconds for maintenance pods, long enough that an in-flight sweep or Lance write is not SIGKILLed.

preStopSeconds.description: Seconds every pod sleeps in preStop before SIGTERM, so endpoint removal propagates first.

sidecarBlockShutdownSeconds.description: Seconds the Dapr sidecar keeps running after SIGTERM to flush acks; must lie between preStopSeconds and the grace period.

teardownSeconds.description: Seconds reserved for the app's lifespan teardown; uvicorn's graceful-shutdown bound is grace - preStop - this.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Pod grace period in seconds; must be at least preStop + sidecar drain + 5 s buffer.

arrivalDlqTopic.description: Dead-letter topic of the write-event lane, for deliveries that exhaust their retries; set only with `dapr.resiliency.enabled`, since a dead-letter topic with no retry policy parks on the first failure.

arrivalEnabled.description: Subscribe the write-event lane: queue the written table's pass on each announced commit.

controlEmit.description: Announce each reclamation on the catalog control topic (catalog.control.v1); needs Dapr sidecars. Off by default.

daprAppId.description: Dapr app-id of the maintenance service; also names its durable consumer.

discoveryMaxDepth.description: How deep the bucket walk descends looking for a dataset's `_versions/`; a subtree it stops inside is an IncompleteScan that blocks the purge.

driftRepair.description: Revoke OpenFGA tuples whose object no registry names (ghost projects/warehouses/tables); deletes tuples only. Off by default.

driftRepairDryRun.description: Plan and report drift repair without deleting any tuple. Defaults true.

driftRepairMaxPerTick.description: Maximum objects drift repair revokes per reconcile tick; the remainder is reported as capped and taken next tick.

enabled.description: Deploy the maintenance service (its worker, the hourly audit and the write-event lane).

floorRaise.description: Write one metadata-only commit per stranded dataset to raise its Lance listing floor so residue becomes reclaimable. Off by default.

floorRaiseDryRun.description: Plan and report floor raises without committing. Defaults true; set false to commit once `floorRaise` is on.

floorRaiseMaxPerTick.description: Maximum datasets the floor raise commits to per tick; the remainder is reported as capped.

lineageEmit.description: Emit a lineage event per dataset whose versions a pass reclaimed and a FAIL event per errored one; covers every table the catalog's `__manifest` names.

minVersionsToExpire.description: Expiry runs on a table only once it has at least this many reclaimable versions.

olderThanDays.description: Days of version history kept by old-version GC.

orphanScan.description: Run the reconciler's per-dataset unreferenced-file scan; read-only, and required for `trashPurge` to certify a clean report.

port.description: HTTP port of the maintenance container.

ackWaitSeconds.description: Consumer ack wait, in seconds: how long a task a dead worker held waits before another replica gets it. A worker whose heartbeats the bus stops answering ends itself before the ack wait its last answered heartbeat restarted runs out, so its pass never runs beside the next.

auditSchedule.description: The audit's NATS message schedule (ADR-51): the drift report without the orphan scan, its repairs and the lost-task backstop, once per firing on one replica.

commitPassDelaySeconds.description: How long the first commit of a burst holds its table's pass: the most often commits pass a table, each pass covering every commit before it.

drainSeconds.description: How long a stopping replica lets its running task finish, inside `lifecycle.maintenanceTerminationGracePeriodSeconds`. A pass still running when the drain ends ends its replica, since its heartbeat ends with the drain and the task would reach another replica while it ran on. The drain runs after uvicorn's own graceful wait, so that wait is cut by it: the pod's grace less preStop, the teardown and this.

heartbeatSeconds.description: How often a running task tells JetStream it is still being worked on; well inside `ackWaitSeconds`.

maxDeliver.description: Deliveries of one task before it is ended and counted (`maintenance.tasks.ended`); the consumer allows one more, on which a task that outlived its worker every time is ended without running.

maxPassSeconds.description: A pass running longer than this is logged and counted; at twice this its replica exits, Kubernetes restarts it, and the task is delivered again.

recheckHours.description: The longest a table goes without a pass: what bounds a lost commit event, and the versions a deleted tag or branch releases.

retrySeconds.description: When a pass that could not decide, or found the table's history held, is tried again.

scanSchedule.description: The scan's NATS message schedule, a six-field cron (seconds first): the audit with the orphan scan, which opens every table, then the listing floors and the trash purge its report certifies. Off the hour, so it does not fire with the hourly audit: the two never run at once, and the later one waits out the other's claim.

storeEventsMaxBytes.description: The most STORE_EVENTS holds, in bytes, before it drops its oldest: each event is a hint of about 2 KB that the table's daily recheck backs up, and the stream shares the bus's JetStream disk with LINEAGE and the work queue.

replicas.description: Maintenance replicas; each runs a worker on the shared work queue.

tombstoneSweep.description: Clear trash records whose bytes a probe proves are gone; deletes bookkeeping rows, never bytes. Off by default.

tombstoneSweepDryRun.description: Plan and report the tombstone sweep without clearing anything. Defaults true.

tombstoneSweepMaxPerTick.description: Maximum trash records the tombstone sweep probes and clears per tick; the remainder is reported as capped.

trashPurge.description: Delete the bytes of trash records past their grace deadline and revoke their grants, only when that scan's drift report is clean. Irreversible; off by default.

trashPurgeDryRun.description: Run the purge pass for real but perform no mutation, reporting `would_purge`; adds full read cost.

trashPurgeMaxPerTick.description: Maximum trash records purged per tick; the remainder is reported as capped and drained next tick.

tupleRebuild.description: Recreate OpenFGA tuples the control-plane registries still justify (project admin seed, warehouse tenancy); additive only. Off by default.

tupleRebuildDryRun.description: Plan and report the tuple rebuild without writing. Defaults true.

tupleRebuildMaxPerTick.description: Maximum tuples the rebuild writes per tick; the remainder is reported as capped.

vendWriteCredentials.description: Wire maintenance to the catalog's vending door, the only credential its rewrites are signed with; off, maintenance holds no maintain rung and refuses every rewrite.

buckets.description: Map of tier namespace to S3 bucket (e.g. `{gold: lance-sink}`); unset namespaces use `objectStore.bucket`. Listed buckets are auto-created, swept by maintenance and reserved from warehouses.

nameOverride.description: Overrides the chart name used in `rask.name` labels when `fullnameOverride` is empty. Empty uses the chart name.

flagged.description: Extra user grants keyed by a values flag path, or several joined by `,` that must all be true, merged into `nats.auth.users` only while the key holds (lance.natsTable).

provisioned.description: Attests the platform's store holds every `nats-user-<user>`; required when the store is the platform's (`openbao.enabled` false).

users.description: The bus user table, one user per Dapr app-id plus admin and monitor, each with publish and subscribe subject lists (never empty).

streamMaxAgeSeconds.description: Seconds a message is kept on the LINEAGE, DLQ and CATALOG_CONTROL streams before the stream drops it (max_age).

streamReplicas.description: Raft replica count for every stream the stream Job provisions; must not exceed the bus's node count.

url.description: NATS JetStream address every pub/sub component and the stream Job connect to (e.g. nats://nats.internal:4222). Required: empty fails the render.

apiServerEgress.description: NetworkPolicy egress rules ({to, ports}) admitting the pods that call the Kubernetes API to its endpoints. Required under networkPolicy.enabled while any such pod renders.

enabled.description: Renders default-deny NetworkPolicies with explicit allows and exclusive client lists for the guarded stores. Needs a policy-enforcing CNI.

extraEgress.description: List of extra egress rules, verbatim NetworkPolicy entries, for external backends (off-cluster S3, managed NATS, Postgres, the IdP). Each rule names its `to` peers; the render refuses one that admits every destination.

objectStoreExtraFrom.description: List of extra NetworkPolicy `from` peers allowed to reach the object store.

openbaoExtraFrom.description: List of extra NetworkPolicy `from` peers allowed to reach the development store (`openbao.enabled`; e.g. the external-secrets namespace).

accessKey.description: Access key id of the store's root account (`rustfsadmin` is RustFS's built-in default id); its secret is `object-store-secret-key` in `<release>-object-store-root`, which only the store and the provisioning hook mount. No workload presents it.

bucket.description: The lakehouse root bucket (catalog `LANCE_REST_ROOT`, warehouse registry, lineage outbox).

buckets.description: Extra platform buckets the provisioning hook creates on the dev store and the reconcile exempts from orphan_buckets; governed tiers only, not the root or feature buckets.

enabled.description: This estate uses the development object store (deploy/fixtures/rustfs, Service `<release>-rustfs`): rask runs its provisioning hook against it (the platform buckets and every identity's policy), and the dev secret store issues its root credential. Off with `externalEndpoint` set uses the platform's S3. The chart renders no store server.

provisioned.description: Attests that the platform's store (`objectStore.enabled=false`) delivers every object write of every rask bucket (`s3:ObjectCreated:*`) to the bus subject `store.events`, kept through a bus outage; the render refuses a platform store without it.

externalEndpoint.description: S3 endpoint the apps use instead of the development store; pair with `objectStore.enabled=false`. Empty uses the development store. https on a real deployment: the render refuses an http one.

audience.description: The audience every lakehouse workload's store token is projected for, which the object store trusts as its identity provider's client (the rustfs fixture's `identityProvider.clientId`; `sts.amazonaws.com` for AWS). Required.

backup-control-root.description: The role the control-root backup's token is exchanged for (`backups.controlRoot`).

backup-pg.description: The role the pg dump's token is exchanged for (`backups.pgDump`).

catalog.description: The role the catalog's token is exchanged for, for its own IO and every vend.

lineage.description: The role lineage's token is exchanged for.

maintenance.description: The role maintenance's token is exchanged for.

sessionSeconds.description: How long a workload's session lasts (`*_S3_SESSION_SECONDS`, 900 to 43200 s): a service renews its own at half its life, and a backup run asks for one.

port.description: S3 API port of the development store's Service.

enabled.description: Deploy rask's OTel Collector and turn on OTLP export from the lakehouse services, Dapr and OpenFGA to it; needs `export.endpoint`.

environment.description: Value of the `deployment.environment.name` OTel resource attribute; empty falls back to the release namespace.

auditHeaders.description: Headers added to the export of `lance.audit` records, which leave on their own exporter, so a backend can route the governance trail apart from telemetry.

egress.description: NetworkPolicy egress rules ({to, ports}) admitting the Collector to the backend at `endpoint`, at the port a policy sees. Required under networkPolicy.enabled.

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL the Collector exports traces, metrics and logs to (`/v1/traces` etc. are appended); the platform's backend. Required while `enabled`: empty fails the render, and http on a real deployment.

headers.description: Headers sent on every export: the backend's ingestion contract, none by default (the dev overlay names GreptimeDB's).

traceHeaders.description: Headers added to the trace export.

image.description: Container image for the OTel Collector (contrib distribution).

samplingRate.description: Dapr tracing sampling rate in the Dapr Configuration, as a string from 0 to 1; "1" traces every request.

egress.description: NetworkPolicy egress rules ({to, ports}) admitting the store's readers to the platform's store. Required under networkPolicy.enabled when `enabled` is false.

enabled.description: This estate uses the development store (deploy/fixtures/openbao, Service `<release>-openbao`): in memory, initialized and seeded by the scripts this chart renders (`<release>-openbao-seed`), its administrator token generated in-cluster. A real deployment refuses it. False reads the platform's store at `externalAddr`.

externalAddr.description: The platform's Vault or OpenBao (https), which the Dapr secret store and ESO's SecretStore read when `enabled` is false; required then, and refused beside `enabled`.

externalReaders.description: A client's sidecar that reads the store through `lance-secrets`, keyed by its Dapr app id `<app>`: `{serviceAccount, secrets}`, its ServiceAccount in this namespace and the secrets its role may read, supplied from the client's own values so the lakehouse names none. An allowlist: a reader holds only `nats-user-<app>`, names of its own (`<app>-<name>`) and `signing-public-<name>`; the render refuses an app id that is no Dapr id, a lakehouse app, one whose own names would cover a store-issued family (`nats-user-<name>`, `signing-key-<name>`, `signing-public-<name>`) or a name a lakehouse identity, ESO, the dev store's seed or another reader holds, or one whose role `<release>-<app>` is ESO's; and a ServiceAccount the lakehouse renders or `default`.

audience.description: Audience of the token projected into each sidecar for its store login; every app's role accepts only this one.

tokenMaxTtl.description: The longest a sidecar's store token lives; daprd then logs in again with its current projected token.

tokenTtl.description: Lifetime of the store token a sidecar's login returns; daprd renews it in the background.

port.description: Port of the development store's Service.

method.description: Subchart passthrough: OpenFGA API authentication method; `oidc` admits only projected ServiceAccount tokens.

audience.description: Token audience OpenFGA requires; templates/openfga-authn.yaml refuses a render unless it equals `lance.openfgaAudience` (rask-openfga).

issuer.description: Subchart passthrough (tpl-rendered): the OIDC issuer OpenFGA fetches keys from, the release's ServiceAccount issuer mirror.

datastore.description: Subchart passthrough: Postgres datastore on the AGE server, DSN from `rask-infra-credentials`, bundled migrations off (rask's Job migrates), pool 30 open/10 idle.

enabled.description: Install the OpenFGA authorization server subchart, plus rask's migrate Job, authn subject ConfigMap and PodDisruptionBudget for it.

extraEnvVars.description: Subchart passthrough env: OPENFGA_EXPERIMENTALS=weighted_graph_check, the OIDC issuer alias, and the subject allow-list from `rask-openfga-authn`.

http.description: Subchart passthrough: CORS for the OpenFGA HTTP API, closed by allowing only the unreachable origin `https://openfga.invalid`.

tag.description: OpenFGA image tag for the subchart server and for rask's own migrate Job (templates/openfga-migrate.yaml), so schema and binary match.

enabled.description: Subchart passthrough: the OpenFGA browser playground; off, since it only runs with authn `none`.

podAnnotations.description: Subchart passthrough: OpenFGA's pod annotations; `rask.dev/openfga-clients` names the ServiceAccounts its subject list admits, so a change to them restarts it.

replicaCount.description: Subchart passthrough: number of OpenFGA server replicas.

resources.description: Subchart passthrough: CPU and memory requests/limits for the OpenFGA server.

telemetry.description: Subchart passthrough: OpenFGA OTLP tracing to the OTel Collector; off by default, ratio 0.001 because each Check emits ~1,900 spans.

enabled.description: Renders a PodDisruptionBudget for each service running more than one replica.

controlName.description: Name of the broadcast (no queue group) Dapr pubsub component for catalog.control.v1; must match the catalog's LANCE_CONTROL_PUBSUB default. Used when `controlEmit` is on.

name.description: Name of the shared lineage publish Dapr pubsub component; each subscriber app gets a derived `<name>-<app-id>` component with its own queue group.

topic.description: Topic OpenLineage run events are published and subscribed on (LANCE_DAPR_TOPIC and siblings).

age.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the AGE Postgres StatefulSet (lineage and OpenFGA databases).

catalog.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the catalog; requests sized so the HPA CPU target is meaningful.

default.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for every lakehouse app container that names no tier of its own (lance.resources).

lineage.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for lineage; requests sized so the HPA CPU target is meaningful.

otel-collector.description: CPU/memory requests and limits for the OTel Collector; memory limit matches its hardcoded 400 MiB memory_limiter.

enabled.description: Renders the HTTPRoutes publishing each `/api/*` prefix, and `/dex` with the development Dex, on the Gateway `parentRefs` names.

hostnames.description: Hostnames the platform's Gateway routes to this release. Required while `enabled` on a real deployment; empty, on a development estate, the routes match every host the Gateway's listener accepts.

parentRefs.description: Gateways the routes attach to, as Gateway API parentRefs ([{name, namespace, sectionName}]). Required while `enabled`.

age.description: uid/fsGroup for the AGE Postgres pod (postgres image uid/gid 999).

enabled.description: Applies pinned runAsUser/fsGroup securityContexts to the infra pods (the AGE Postgres). Off by default.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Read-only root filesystem for every first-party app container; each gets a writable /tmp emptyDir.

tmpSizeLimit.description: sizeLimit of each app's /tmp emptyDir (upload spool, Lance spill, OTel queue); stops one pod filling the node's disk.

daprAppId.description: Dapr app-id of the catalog; also names its pubsub components and durable consumers.

module.description: uvicorn import path the catalog Deployment runs (templates/services.yaml).

port.description: Container and Service port of the Lance catalog.

replicas.description: Replica count of the catalog; above 1 requires catalog.controlEmit=true or the render fails. Not rendered while autoscaling.enabled: the HPA owns the count.

daprAppId.description: Dapr app-id of lineage; also names its pubsub, DLQ and durable consumers and scopes its relay cron.

deliveriesInFlight.description: How many of lineage's bus deliveries may be unacknowledged at once (its durable consumer's `maxAckPending`).

eventsRetentionDays.description: Days of arrival time the durable /events feed keeps, pruned on the relay tick; bounds how long a consumer's outage it survives. 0 is unbounded.

key.description: Field of that secret the API key is under.

name.description: Secret in the Dapr secret store holding the backend's API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Empty sends none.

endpoint.description: Path the events are POSTed to under `url` (the transport's `endpoint`).

url.description: Base URL of the graph backend the relay forwards every recorded event to (the OpenLineage HTTP transport's `url`). Empty forwards nothing. https on a real deployment: the render refuses an http one.

module.description: uvicorn import path the lineage Deployment runs (templates/services.yaml).

enabled.description: Stages each lineage event to `s3://<objectStore.bucket>/_lineage_outbox` before publishing, drained by the relay. Requires relay.enabled.

port.description: Container and Service port of the lineage service.

provenanceNamespace.description: Namespace the catalog keeps for lineage's feed and edge list (`LANCE_PROVENANCE_NAMESPACE`, `LINEAGE_PROVENANCE_NAMESPACE`).

provenanceRetainVersions.description: Versions maintenance keeps of each provenance table: the namespace's keep-last-N policy, written by the catalog at boot (`LANCE_PROVENANCE_RETAIN_VERSIONS`). Null declares none.

bindingName.description: Name of the relay cron binding; the sidecar POSTs to /<bindingName>.

enabled.description: Renders the relay cron, which drains the lineage outbox, prunes the feed and forwards it. Needs dapr.enabled.

schedule.description: Schedule of the relay tick (Dapr cron syntax, e.g. `@every 30s` or a cron expression).

replicas.description: Replica count of lineage; replicas form a competing-consumer group, so it scales freely.

doors.description: Mode of the bus doors' signature check: "off", "observe" (count would-refuse) or "enforce" (ack and refuse). Always quoted.

enforce.description: Lineage refuses unsigned or non-verifying events when the secret store and auth are also on. False renders no signer sets and lineage verifies nothing.

provisioned.description: Attest that signing keys exist for every identity in the platform's store; the render fails until it is true there.

allowExternalBlobs.description: Allow blob-v2 columns to reference arbitrary external objects (Blob.from_uri) on create. Off by default: an SSRF and dangling-pointer risk; prefer `externalBlobBases`.

encryption.description: Server-side encryption for direct writes, carried in vended storage options: `algorithm` (AES256, aws:kms, aws:kms:dsse) and `kmsKeyId` (kms only, the key ARN under web_identity vending). Empty = bucket default.

endpoint.description: Object-store endpoint every vended credential names (LANCE_S3_VENDED_ENDPOINT). Empty = the catalog's own store endpoint. https on a real deployment: the render refuses an http one.

externalBlobBases.description: Comma-separated allowlist of base URIs external blob pointers may live under (LANCE_EXTERNAL_BLOB_BASES). Empty approves no base.

mode.description: How the catalog vends storage credentials for direct object I/O: `web_identity` (default, its own token exchanged for a per-table session) or `mode_b` (none, server-mediated).

ttlSeconds.description: Lifetime in seconds of a vended STS / web-identity credential (LANCE_VENDING_TTL_SECONDS).
